verdict.rationale: The GST portal homepage offers a 'Log/Track Your Issues here' grievance redressal link, so a founder can track the status of a grievance case from the portal. The pack never shows public status lookup for registration applications or return filings; the dashboard for certificates and notices appears to sit behind login. Missing for 10: documented public tracking of application status (e.g. by ARN), status lookup for return filings, details of what the grievance tracker shows, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
